answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the basalt of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the plume of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sparrow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
